title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
summary: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.
text: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US - BBC News BBC Homepage Skip to content Accessibility Help Your account Home News Sport Earth Reel Worklife Travel Culture Future Music TV Weather Sounds More menu More menu Search BBC Home News Sport Earth Reel Worklife Travel Culture Future Music TV Weather Sounds Close menu BBC News Menu Home Climate World US & Canada UK Business Tech Science Entertainment & Arts Health More In Pictures BBC Verify Newsbeat US & Canada Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US Close Powerful storms are battering both US coasts as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend gets under way. Hundreds of flights have been cancelled and hundreds of thousands are without power, in states including Virginia, North Carolina and New Jersey. Strong winds have blown roofs off houses and floodwater has submerged streets. Read the full story.
